channel.title: RuPaul's Drag Race UK vs the World
channel.desc: The fierce competition continues as our international queens fight to impress Mama Ru and do their countries proud. This time, it's the design challenge - but with a catch - as the queens breathe new life into old looks in the Runway Ru-Mix. And just as the queens catch their breath, Mama Ru teases a brand new twist that comes with game-changing powers. Supermodel and Drag Race fan favourite Kristen McMenamy joins RuPaul on the judging panel alongside Michelle Visage and Alan Carr.
